overloads.semanticRole: The WP New command creates and returns a 4D Write Pro object.

constraints: If source is omitted, an empty 4D Write Pro object is returned.
If source is Text, it must be a 4D HTML source string (as exported by WP EXPORT VARIABLE with wk web page html 4D).

If source is Blob, it must contain either a 4D Write Pro (.4wp) document or a legacy 4D Write document (.4w7/.4wt); option only applies in this legacy-blob case, to control whether HTML expressions are imported as raw text (wk import html expressions as text) or ignored (default).

If source is Object, it must be a range, a body-descendant element (table/row/paragraph/body/header/footer/inline picture/text box/section/subsection/style sheet), or a 4D Write Pro document; passing a range that is not the full document range exports only the first section and does not export bookmarks; passing a document returns a copy of it.
option is only meaningful when source is a Blob containing a legacy 4D Write document; it is ignored otherwise.
